description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Your stand squeezes your heart to a stop. You stay at 1 Hit Point, fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} and appear dead; you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{unconscious} but don't gain the dying condition. A creature that examines you must succeed at a Medicine or Perception check against your stand DC to notice you're alive. Your stand unmanifests. You wake up as a free action at the start of any of your turns, and you're then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round.
